sections.title: Story battles
sections.description: Operation mechanics and preparation, in campaign order. Enemy affinities and skill details are in the combat reference.

entries.title: Awakening tutorial
entries.summary: Follow the scripted first battle on the dorm roof.
steps: Follow the roof objective and combat prompts. Ordinary party preparation begins with the later Tartarus tutorial.

entries.title: Priestess — train
entries.summary: The train timer is part of the fight; scripted reductions make the initial allowance misleading.
steps: Reach the front car promptly. Keep decisions focused as the timer drops during the battle.
Use the summoned Tiaras’ weaknesses to gain extra actions, then return damage to Priestess.
Keep Yukari available to heal; avoid Ice attacks against Priestess.

entries.title: Emperor and Empress
entries.summary: Paradigm Shift changes their vulnerabilities.
steps: Ask Fuuka to analyze both bosses and check again after each shift.
Bring physical and several elemental damage options; attack the current weakness rather than repeating the previous element.
Knock down both for All-Out Attacks. Use support or healing when a character cannot hit either weakness.

entries.title: Hierophant — hotel
entries.summary: Yukari is mandatory, and the hotel contains two consecutive bosses.
steps: Prepare Fear and Charm recovery before departure.
Clear Fear from Doomsday Doctrine promptly and maintain healing.
After the fight, investigate the room’s mirror to continue the hotel sequence.

entries.title: Lovers — mirrors and Charm
entries.summary: Break the mirrors that do not show your reflection to reach the second boss.
steps: Regroup, then break the mirrors in rooms 205 and 304. Return to the large room where Hierophant was fought.
Cure Charm immediately: Heartbreaker punishes charmed targets, who can also help the boss.
Use Yukari’s available Theurgy and attacks that avoid the boss’s blocked elements; keep a second character ready with recovery items.

entries.title: Chariot and Justice
entries.summary: After the tank separates, neither half may remain alive long enough to revive the other.
steps: Guard the tank’s announced charged attack; Theurgy and Almighty damage help against its broad resistance.
Lower both separate bosses together. Plan enough remaining actions to finish the survivor before its next Restore.
A single simultaneous hit is useful but not mandatory: two kills before the survivor acts also work.

sources.label: Chariot and Justice: separation and revival

entries.title: Hermit
entries.summary: Its charging sequence is the main danger.
steps: Save a burst of damage or Theurgy for Initiate Charging; sufficient damage can interrupt it.
Guard if a charged discharge is about to resolve, and restore HP afterward.
Avoid exposed Electric weaknesses. Debuff its attack and maintain party defense.

entries.title: Fortune and Strength
entries.summary: Strength shields Fortune; the wheel runs automatically in Reload.
steps: Focus on Strength first, using magic or Theurgy against its physical resistance.
Keep the protagonist and other essential party members above 300 HP before the damage wheel. Its scripted 300-damage result is not a timing minigame.
After Strength falls, exploit Fortune’s Strike or Electric weakness. The late death-symbol wheel is a scripted fake-out.

sources.label: Fortune and Strength: protection and survival

entries.title: Takaya and Jin — Moonlight Bridge
entries.summary: Their knockdowns and Shifts can chain into a lethal follow-up.
steps: Focus Jin to remove his grenades and support skills.
Clear Confuse and defense debuffs; remove their Heat Riser with Dekaja.
Protect the protagonist from instant kills and keep recovery available for Hanged Man immediately afterward.

sources.label: Takaya and Jin: grenade / Vile Assault combination

entries.title: Hanged Man
entries.summary: Destroy its statues to bring the main body into reach.
steps: Cover Strike, Slash and Pierce: the initial left, middle and right statues are weak to those types respectively.
Exploit statue weaknesses and use All-Out Attacks, then concentrate damage on the grounded boss.
Prepare for later statue waves, including the large statue. Remove Heat Riser and guard dangerous charged attacks after Grim Transcendence.

sources.label: Hanged Man: statue weaknesses and Grim Transcendence

entries.title: Chidori
entries.summary: This encounter ends through its scripted battle sequence.
steps: Keep dealing damage while healing through Maragidyne and clearing Confuse.
Avoid Fire damage. Continue after Spring of Life restores her HP; survival and continued attacks advance the encounter.

sources.label: Chidori: Spring of Life and scripted conclusion

entries.title: Jin — final ascent
entries.summary: Weakness Scan lets Jin target the party’s vulnerabilities.
steps: Cover weaknesses and carry Confuse recovery for Flash Grenade EX.
When Potent Stim Injection restores his HP and strengthens him, heal and guard through the burst. His self-inflicted Poison drains his health.
Expect scripted HP stops: do not spend every resource trying to skip the required phase actions.

sources.label: January 31: Jin phase stops and Poison

entries.title: Takaya — final ascent
entries.summary: His late Theurgy leaves the party afraid and almost without SP.
steps: Bring party-wide Fear recovery such as Amrita Shower and reserve SP items.
Cure Fear immediately after Paradise of Quietus, before Ghastly Wail.
Continue with physical skills or restore SP, while healing and maintaining debuffs.

sources.label: Takaya: Soul Drain, Theurgy and Ghastly Wail

entries.title: Nyx Avatar
entries.summary: Fourteen Arcana forms change the fight as it progresses.
steps: Check affinities after every Arcana Shift. Renew useful debuffs rather than assuming they persist.
Keep recovery reserves for the final Death form; guard charged attacks during the preceding phases.
Heal immediately after Apocalypse removes almost all current HP, then recover from Night Queen’s damage and ailments.
After the boss, follow the final scripted confrontation through Great Seal.

sources.label: Nyx Avatar: Arcana phases and Death
January 31: Arcana shifts and final sequence

sections.title: Ending route
sections.description: The December decision determines whether the playable campaign continues into January.

entries.title: December 31 — preserve the January route
entries.summary: Spare Ryoji at both decision prompts.
steps: Make a separate save before the evening decision.
Choose to spare Ryoji, then reaffirm sparing him when he asks again.
Killing him selects the shortened ending and skips January. Sparing him opens the final month; no Social Link rank is required.

entries.title: January finale and March epilogue
entries.summary: Complete the January 31 ascent to reach the concluding school days.
steps: Finish remaining optional daytime plans by January 30. Prepare and ascend on January 31.
After the final battle, continue the March farewell sequence through the March 5 rooftop ending.
Save Clear Data after the credits if you want New Game Plus.

sources.label: Original completed-playthrough essay: March 5 graduation ending

sections.title: Linked Episodes and missable branches
sections.description: Complete each character’s events in sequence. Use the calendar for individual available days inside these windows.

entries.title: Shinjiro — retain and return the extension form
entries.summary: Finish the September chain before October 4, then collect the final item from his room.
steps: Start with Mitsuru in the faculty hallway, then meet Shinjiro at the station outskirts. Complete his first three episodes.
When Mitsuru discusses the form, choose “Wait a minute.” at the final prompt to keep it.
Return the form to Shinjiro and complete his next event by October 2.
From October 5, inspect the desk drawer in his dorm room. This branch does not prevent the October story event.
rewards: Hell Biker fusion unlock from the final room item.

entries.title: Ryoji — Kyoto invitation
entries.summary: The automatic first meeting alone does not complete his chain.
steps: Continue after November 9 with his second event during November 12–16.
Speak to him at the Kyoto hotel on November 18 and accept his invitation.
Meet him on December 1, then spare him on December 31 to complete the chain.

entries.title: Junpei — five episodes
entries.summary: The flower branch is optional for his Persona unlock.
steps: Complete episodes in order: May 12–July 3; August 9–28; early November; December 19–26; January 15–29.
Prioritize the November event during November 7–11 so there is time for the optional flower branch.
rewards: Surt fusion unlock after episode 5; the optional flower is not required.

entries.title: Junpei — white flower branch
entries.summary: An optional November action adds a January 21 scene.
steps: After Junpei’s third episode, buy the White Flower at Rafflesia in Port Island Station and give it to him at the dorm. Do this promptly; the gift costs no time slot.
Complete the gift by November 20. A November 30 late-night scene confirms the branch.
Reserve January 21 after school for the resulting revival scene.
requirements: Junpei episodes 1–3 complete.
¥250 for the White Flower.
rewards: Optional Chidori revival scene on January 21.

sources.label: Chidori revival: third episode, flower deadline and confirmation

entries.title: Akihiko — five episodes
entries.summary: Keep each event in order rather than saving the whole chain for January.
steps: Windows: May 29–July 10; July 24–August 31; October 9–November 2; December 12–22; January 4–29.
Check the calendar for the actual invitation days in each window.

entries.title: Koromaru — five episodes
entries.summary: Several middle episodes share a long window, but still require the preceding event.
steps: Start from August 22. Continue the three middle episodes from September 4.
Complete the final episode from January 5, finishing by January 30.

entries.title: Ken — five episodes
entries.summary: His first two episodes must both be completed during September.
steps: Complete the first from September 8 and the second from September 15, both by September 30.
Continue November 10–December 2, December 22–30 and January 19–27.

entries.title: Takaya — final follow-up
entries.summary: The summer encounters have a January follow-up.
steps: After the automatic August 14, August 20 and September 18 events, visit Club Escapade during January 13–29.
Speak to the suspicious man and agree to hear him out.
rewards: Final story follow-up to the Folded Paper encounters.

sections.title: Optional late-game bosses
sections.description: Preparation rules for the Reaper, Monad’s final guardian and Elizabeth.

entries.title: Reaper
entries.summary: Lingering on a hostile Tartarus floor eventually brings a much stronger enemy.
steps: Prepare buffs, debuffs, weakness protection and reliable healing before deliberately waiting.
Respect its extra actions and guard charged Almighty attacks; reflection cannot stop Megidolaon.
Armageddon offers a late-game one-hit route when unlocked. Ordinary damage builds can also win.
rewards: Bloody Button for the related request.

entries.title: Shadow of the Void
entries.summary: The guardian at the end of the 255F Monad Passage regenerates 300 HP per turn.
steps: Maintain buffs and defense debuffs, then concentrate damage so healing does not erase your progress.
There is no elemental weakness to exploit. Theurgy provides reliable burst damage; Armageddon can end the encounter immediately.
requirements: Reach the end of the 255F Monad Passage.

sources.label: Shadow of the Void: 255F and regeneration

entries.title: Elizabeth — entry and prohibitions
entries.summary: A solo fight with strict retaliation rules; New Game Plus is not required.
steps: Complete requests 81, 99 and 100, then accept request 101 when eligible from January 1. Enter alone; Fuuka may support you.
Do not let an attack actually hit Null, Drain or Repel. Remove Counter effects and the Omnipotent Orb. Ordinary resistance and ailment protection are usable.
Reserve Armageddon for a killing blow. Prepare Endure and Enduring Soul as separate once-per-battle survival effects.
As a conservative target, finish before turn 50. Track damage so you can manage the phase thresholds deliberately.
requirements: Request 101 accepted.
A prepared solo build and two separate survival effects.

sources.label: Solo restrictions, phases and survival skills

entries.title: Elizabeth — HP thresholds
entries.summary: She begins at 20,000 HP and fully heals once during the intended sequence.
steps: Above 13,000 HP, learn the eight-Persona rotation and bank your burst.
Crossing 13,000 starts the timed damage phase: get below 10,000 before its turn-5 repeated 9,999 attacks. Survive its earlier scripted 9,999 with one survival effect.
The first crossing below 10,000 triggers a full heal. Work her below 10,000 a second time.
Survive the next scripted 9,999 attack with your remaining survival effect, then use Armageddon before she heals again.
requirements: Helel and Satan registered for Armageddon.
rewards: Omnipotent Orb from completing the ultimate-adversary request.

sections.title: Protagonist Theurgy
sections.description: Register both listed Personas, then speak with Elizabeth. The pair need not remain in your stock after the ability unlocks.

entries.title: Cadenza
entries.summary: Restore half the party’s HP and raise accuracy/evasion.
steps: Register Orpheus + Apsaras in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: Jack Brothers
entries.summary: Medium Almighty damage to all enemies, with a high chance of knockdown.
steps: Register Jack Frost + Jack-o’-Lantern in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: King and I
entries.summary: Heavy Ice damage to all enemies, bypassing affinities, with a chance to Freeze.
steps: Register King Frost + Black Frost in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: Best Friends
entries.summary: Apply Charge and Concentrate to one ally.
steps: Register Forneus + Decarabia in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: Scarlet Havoc
entries.summary: Severe Slash damage to all enemies, bypassing affinities.
steps: Register Mithras + Siegfried in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: Trickster
entries.summary: Massive Almighty damage to all enemies, with a chance of a random ailment.
steps: Register Loki + Susano-o in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

entries.title: Armageddon
entries.summary: Deal 9,999 Almighty damage to every enemy; the protagonist is left at 1 HP and 1 SP.
steps: Register Helel + Satan in the Compendium, then visit Elizabeth.
requirements: Theurgy system unlocked through the June story.

sections.title: New Game Plus
sections.description: Create Clear Data after the ending, then load that save to begin another campaign.

entries.title: Standard carryover
entries.summary: Outside Merciless, much of your accumulated strength and inventory carries forward.
steps: Keep a separate pre-finale save, and register custom Personas before finishing.
Carryover includes protagonist level and social stats, money, Compendium registrations, equipment, most inventory, Twilight Fragments, scan information and permanent stat-item gains.
Fusion-unlock key items from completed Social Links and Linked Episodes remain useful. Story progress, Social Link ranks and episode chains restart.
requirements: A completed-game Clear Data save.

sources.label: Clear Data, carryover and Merciless exceptions

entries.title: Merciless carryover restriction
entries.summary: Starting the new campaign on Merciless discards almost all gameplay carryover.
steps: Expect to rebuild levels, social stats, money, equipment and the Compendium.
Costumes, souvenirs and playtime are the notable retained categories. Choose a different difficulty for a run that uses your previous combat and social progress.
requirements: A completed-game Clear Data save.

sources.label: Clear Data, carryover and Merciless exceptions

sections.title: Tartarus exploration
sections.description: Run preparation, battle rewards and the systems that extend an expedition.

entries.title: Shuffle Time and Arcana Burst
entries.summary: Finish a battle with an All-Out Attack to guarantee Shuffle Time.
steps: Coins give money; Wands give experience; Cups give recovery or buffs; Swords give skill cards. Read the displayed card reward before choosing.
Fill the displayed Major Arcana slots to trigger Arcana Burst: subsequent Minor Arcana ranks rise by one for that expedition.

Story bosses and Monad rewards expand the available Major Arcana pool. Decide which bonuses you want before filling your slots. Leaving Tartarus ends the expedition bonuses; permanent stat gains remain.

sources.label: Shuffle Time: displayed capacity and one-rank Arcana Burst

entries.title: Major Arcana — growth
entries.summary: Permanent stat rewards apply when selected.
steps: Emperor: stock Personas +2 Strength/Magic. Empress: stock Personas +2 Endurance/Agility/Luck. Tower: stock Personas +1 all stats.
Hierophant: equipped Persona +1 level. Chariot: protagonist +10 maximum HP. Hermit: protagonist +7 maximum SP.
Fortune: current party +8 maximum HP. Strength: current party +5 maximum SP. Judgement: extra experience for the lowest-level party member.

entries.title: Major Arcana — expedition bonuses
entries.summary: Choose cards that support the purpose of this visit.
steps: Fool: more battle experience. Priestess: stronger All-Out Attacks. Lovers: stronger Social Link fusion experience.
Justice and Star: each adds one Shuffle Time selection. Sun: fuse up to five levels above the protagonist.
Devil: double battle and breakable-object item drops. Moon: fully restore current party HP/SP.

entries.title: Major Arcana — items and the next day
entries.summary: Some rewards serve plans outside the current battle.
steps: Magician: a rare item. Hanged Man: a random incense.
Temperance: improved social-stat gains on the following day. Plan the next day’s activity around it.

sources.label: Major Arcana: item rewards and Temperance

entries.title: Monad Doors — temporary encounters
entries.summary: The first door is introduced on 80F; later doors appear during exploration.
steps: Enter a door before leaving its floor if you want that encounter; an ignored door closes when you move on.
Prepare for a stronger enemy and collect the treasure after winning. These optional fights offer materials and useful Shuffle Time rewards.
Check the enemy reference for the current block’s encounter rather than assuming every door contains the same enemy.

entries.title: Monad Passages — persistent challenges
entries.summary: The first Passage is on 91F. These fixed challenges can be revisited.
steps: Clear every encounter and collect the final key item: it unlocks the next Passage in the sequence.
Return later if underprepared. Unlike a random Door, the Passage does not vanish when you leave the floor.
Collect the Major Arcana rewards to expand future Shuffle Time choices. The last optional challenges are covered in the late-game boss section.

entries.title: Twilight Fragments and healing clocks
entries.summary: Locked chests and full recovery compete for the same fragments.
steps: Collect the fixed town pickups, break blue-glowing objects in Tartarus and claim Elizabeth’s Social Link/request rewards. Rescued cats can also provide fragments.
Locked chests show their fragment cost. Keep a reserve for the fixed chests whose equipment you want.
The entrance healing clock costs seven fragments to restore party HP and SP. Returning to the entrance alone does not provide free recovery.

entries.title: Great Clock — reserve-member catch-up
entries.summary: Introduced in Yabbashah, this is separate from the seven-fragment healing clock.
steps: Opening fragment-locked chests can reveal its entrance. Go through when it appears.
Select two lower-level companions, then put them into battle to receive the displayed catch-up levels.

Use the selected companions before searching for another Clock; an unclaimed battle level-up can prevent the next one appearing. Check the Clock’s preview rather than assuming an unlimited jump to your level.

sources.label: Great Clock: access and selecting companions
Great Clock: pending level-ups prevent another appearance

entries.title: Avoiding the Reaper
entries.summary: Lingering on one hostile floor attracts it after its introduction.
steps: Move to the stairs or a teleporter when Fuuka warns you. Do not wait beside an approaching Reaper while planning your route.
Treat dark floors cautiously: it can arrive sooner there. Continue exploration on another floor instead of trying to outwait it.

entries.title: Prepare and recover during an expedition
entries.summary: Plan around SP, checkpoints and the month’s rescue deadlines.
steps: Bring elemental coverage, healing, revival and ailment-recovery items. Use the calendar to check missing-person deadlines before departing.
Activate return points as you climb. Return to the entrance to save, change the party or fuse Personas before a difficult encounter.
Use low-cost weakness hits and All-Out Attacks to conserve SP. Take recovery cards when needed, or use the healing clock if extending the visit is worth seven fragments.
Stop at the current story barrier; the floor progression reference shows when the next section opens.

sources.label: Exploration tutorials: return points, SP and recovery

entries.title: Duplicate skill cards at Inari
entries.summary: The small shrine at Naganaki can copy one card per day without consuming a time slot.
steps: Bring a skill card you already own and choose it at the Inari shrine during the day. The copy is immediate and free.
Keep a spare copy of a valuable card before teaching it to a Persona, so you can duplicate it again later.

evidenceNotes.note: Original Steam guide 3206753509 reports a 100-turn limit; several English guides report 50. The player entry recommends finishing before 50 and does not claim that either exact hard limit is verified.

Aqiu lists episode 3 through November 11; Game8 Japan lists through November 13 and the flower through November 20. The advice uses the earlier episode window and the explicitly sourced November 20 gift deadline.
Some guides incorrectly name Lucifer for Armageddon or a single target for Scarlet Havoc. This dataset uses Helel + Satan and all-enemy Scarlet Havoc.
No Moonless Gown instruction is included: that Nyx mechanic belongs to earlier Persona 3 versions. Exact Takaya phase percentages are omitted because original guides disagree.

The original Sharbit battle guide documents automatic wheel damage up to 300 and links its recorded fight. Exact scripted wheel behavior is corroborated by the Reload-specific wiki section; the embedded video was not independently watched during this pass.

Guides disagree on a guaranteed fragment-spend threshold and often omit the catch-up cap. The reference uses the observed chest trigger and in-game level preview without asserting a universal 19-fragment guarantee or unlimited leveling.
